basics.name: João Pedro Moreira Campos de Lima
basics.label: Full Stack Developer
basics.summary: Backend software engineer focused on automation, data, and systems, turning manual processes into operable APIs, microservices, and pipelines. Works with Python/FastAPI, Java/Spring Boot, and C#/.NET, as well as SQL, Docker, and CI/CD, delivering service integrations, data-driven backends, and resilient automations for continuous execution.

work.name: NUVEN - IFCE
work.summary: Data platform for social media monitoring and content analysis, focused on intelligence, automation, and decision support.
highlights: Designed ETL pipelines to collect, normalize, and enrich data from Instagram, Facebook, and LinkedIn, consolidating 3 networks into a single analytical base for comparison, monitoring, and continuous performance tracking.
Structured an event-driven integration with Apache Kafka, decoupling ingestion, processing, and analytical consumption while reducing friction between services and development teams.
Delivered dashboards, analytical queries, and KPIs over thousands of records per cycle, turning raw data into operational visibility for decision-making.
Applied automatic classification and virality prediction models to structured and unstructured data, scaling analyses that would otherwise depend on manual triage.

work.name: Movias - UECE
work.summary: Python microservices stack for vehicle data ingestion, updates, and prediction.
highlights: Designed Python/FastAPI microservices and REST APIs for extracting, updating, and predicting vehicle data, separating collection, AI, and integration into a more modular and operable stack.
Evolved the AI service with CSV ingestion, profile updates, and classification and clustering models with K-Means, automating segmentations that had previously been performed manually.
Implemented a unified gateway with Swagger/OpenAPI and health checks for 2 critical services, reducing integration friction and accelerating troubleshooting.
Containerized 100% of the environment with Docker, cutting local setup from hours to minutes and standardizing execution across development and testing.

work.name: LabVicia - IFCE
work.summary: Evolution of Integra-MEC, SETEC/MEC's administrative system, focused on backend, security, and critical internal workflows.
highlights: Developed full stack modules for Integra-MEC with Java, Spring Boot, Angular, and TypeScript, supporting critical administrative workflows for SETEC/MEC in an institutional environment.
Implemented authentication, authorization, and access segregation with Keycloak, expanding security and governance for multiple user profiles.
Delivered REST APIs, filters, pagination, reports, and HTML templates that reduced operational rework and increased the administrative team's autonomy.
Worked end-to-end on corrective maintenance and feature evolution, connecting backend, frontend, and business rules to accelerate delivery with lower regression risk.

work.name: Núcleo de Desenvolvimento de Software (NDS) - IFCE
work.summary: Backend development in .NET focused on APIs, microservices, and delivery quality.
highlights: Developed and maintained REST APIs in C#/.NET for backend services, delivering new endpoints and fixes in a microservices-oriented architecture.
Applied CQRS to separate commands and queries, simplifying domain evolution and reducing the impact of business-rule changes.
Implemented MySQL integrations, SQL queries, and unit tests with mocks, increasing backend reliability and reducing regressions across iterative cycles.
Participated in code reviews and Scrum and Kanban ceremonies, contributing to continuous delivery cadence and raising the team's technical standard.

education.institution: Federal Institute of Education, Science and Technology of Ceará (IFCE)

volunteer.position: Full Stack Developer - Open Source Contribution
volunteer.summary: Open source contribution to the evolution of UBL, an academic platform for browsing curricula, courses, and student progress.
highlights: Contributed to UBL's academic portal with Next.js, React, TypeScript, tRPC, Prisma, and PostgreSQL, improving curriculum navigation and course lookup for 2 undergraduate programs.
Implemented authentication, route protection, validations, and rate limiting, strengthening security and reliability for public and authenticated usage.
Developed progress-tracking flows and learning-path organization, reducing usage friction and improving content discovery.
Standardized the environment and delivery with Docker, Prisma, and GitHub Actions, automating build and deployment through CI/CD.

projects.name: Gatekeeper
projects.description: Continuous automation system to monitor promotions and claim free Epic Games titles, combining integrations, browser automation, hybrid scraping, and containerized operation.
highlights: Built a hybrid scraping pipeline with aiohttp and Playwright to monitor promotions, navigate Epic Games dynamic flows, and execute automatic claiming without manual intervention.

Implemented end-to-end authentication, redirect handling, and adaptation to layout changes, along with hCaptcha solving through Gemini 2.5 Flash, increasing the robustness of an automation exposed to unstable UI behavior.
Persisted execution state in SQLite and the browser profile in a dedicated volume, avoiding reprocessing of already claimed items and sustaining recurring execution with local history.
Containerized the application and automated execution with Docker and GitHub Actions, enabling recurring operation with little manual intervention.
